## sub_55F0D0_0055f0d0 — CPUDetectionAndBenchmark

**Summary:** Detects CPU vendor, model, and feature set via CPUID instruction, measures approximate clock speed using RDTSC timing, and queries system memory via GlobalMemoryStatus. Assigns a CPU performance tier (0–4) used for graphics/audio quality auto-configuration. Part of the render/UI system initialization.

**Frame-path:** NOT_FOUND

**Guard conditions:** The main guard chain: (1) If processor type is not 486 or 586, skips CPU detection entirely (goes to LABEL_74). (2) If CPUID wrapper (sub_5567F5) fails, falls through to "NonCompatibleCPU" path copying an error string. (3) If CPUID succeeds, cascading string-compare checks against "GenuineIntel", "AuthenticAMD", "CyrixInstead" vendor strings drive the CPU model detection switch trees. (4) At the end, if measured CPU speed ≥1500 MHz, cpuTier is forced to 4 regardless of detected model tier. (5) If config data (a2) is provided and has entries, the config parser sub_55BE20 is called to process additional hardware config.
